name: devops-lab5-kubernetes-kubepulse
description: KubePulse — Kubernetes Deployments, Services, Scaling (HPA) and Rolling Updates with zero-downtime validation

scripts.image:build: docker build --build-arg APP_VERSION=1.0.0 -t kubepulse:1.0.0 . && docker build --build-arg APP_VERSION=2.0.0 -t kubepulse:2.0.0 . && docker build --build-arg APP_VERSION=3.0.0 --build-arg BROKEN=true -t kubepulse:3.0.0-broken .
scripts.image:load: kind load docker-image kubepulse:1.0.0 kubepulse:2.0.0 kubepulse:3.0.0-broken --name kubepulse
scripts.validate:all: node scripts/validate-deployment.js && node scripts/validate-resilience.js && node scripts/validate-rollout.js && node scripts/validate-scaling.js

author: Achindra Sharma <2547105>
